notes.title: Added more JUICE to Shape Shooter!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37854648/22a03622904f8494b2afde7372536fbdac170f1e.png[/img]

In the latest update, the game feel of Shape Shooter has been improved. Making the game feel more satisfying. Also called Juice!
This includes stuff like:
[list]
[*] Improved visual effects
[*] Screen shake
[*] Adjustment to sound effects
[*] More animations to menus and game
[*] More particle effects!
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Etc.
[/list]

A new trailer is also made for this occasion.

Try it out, check if you can feel the difference, and maybe get a top spot on the leaderboard in the process. Good luck!
